why_agent_cannot: the drop requires a Telegram or Discord account session
what_human_must_do: 1 Step 1 : Open the Bombie homepage Go to bombie.xyz and select Play Now to reach the game, which is offered on Telegram and LINE.
2 Step 2 : Start the game on Telegram or LINE Launch Bombie in the messaging app you prefer.
3 Step 3 : Slay zombies to earn BOMBIE Play the game and kill zombies, which the homepage names as the way to earn BOMBIE.
4 Step 4 : Complete the tasks in the game The homepage lists tasks for prizes. Check the game for any tasks on offer, since the project does not describe them on its homepage.
